reviews.text: Such a great experience here! I’ve been twice and each time the stylists are kind and welcoming. Anna has done my hair both times and both times I left very happy. I also like that the salon isn’t so big with so many stylists and sounds! Highly recommend!
I absolutely love my hair! The blonde highlights turned out beautiful and look natural, bright, and perfectly blended. I’m so happy with the results and would definitely recommend them. Five stars!

I had Alyssa move up my extensions for me and she did wonderful! It was much quicker than I expected too. Overall great experience! Would recommend for hair extensions as she knows her craft for sure. It also helps because she has fine hair like I do so she understands my hair pretty well.
